description: This file contains system initialization code for the NXP i.MX MCIMX7 M4 SoC, including clock setup, RDC configuration, and peripheral clock gating functions.

methods.name: SOC_ClockInit
methods.description: Initializes the system clocks and enables necessary clock gates for peripherals.

methods.name: SOC_RdcInit
methods.description: Configures the RDC domain for the M4 core.

methods.name: nxp_mcimx7_gpio_config
methods.description: Configures GPIO peripherals and their clock gating.

methods.name: nxp_mcimx7_uart_config
methods.description: Configures UART peripherals and their clock gating.

methods.name: nxp_mcimx7_i2c_config
methods.description: Configures I2C peripherals and their clock gating.

methods.name: nxp_mcimx7_pwm_config
methods.description: Configures PWM peripherals and their clock gating.

methods.name: nxp_mcimx7_mu_config
methods.description: Configures the MU (Messaging Unit) for the M4 core.

methods.name: nxp_mcimx7_init
methods.description: Performs overall SoC initialization, calling specific configuration functions.
